repairs.text: Sí, truca abans de venir. T’ho explicaré per telèfon. Aquest matí ja he comprovat la guitarra de préstec i només falta que la guardem a la funda.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce funda /ˈfun.də/ with stressed U and audible N followed by D: FUN-da, never funa or fona. Keep the adult male Elies voice; do not read this instruction. Prior renderings omitted D or changed U to O. Give the N-D transition enough articulation to hear both consonants, without adding a vowel or spelling letters aloud.

repairs.text: De res, Biel. Espera, que t’aguanto la funda mentre hi poses el full... així... Fins dijous, i ja m’explicaràs com va l’assaig.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce funda /ˈfun.də/ with stressed U and audible N followed by D: FUN-da, never funa or fona. Keep the adult male Elies voice; do not read this instruction. Prior renderings omitted D or changed U to O. Give the N-D transition enough articulation to hear both consonants, without adding a vowel or spelling letters aloud.

repairs.text: Aquí tens el carro, amb una nansa a cada extrem. La bossa ja és dins d’aquesta funda. Obro la porta: prova’l.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce funda /ˈfun.də/ with stressed U and audible N followed by D: FUN-da, never funa or fona. Keep the adult male Elies/Algieba voice throughout the whole turn. Do not read this instruction.
